opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.summary: We support projects where there is a clear ecological science focus to the work; any other aspects, i.e. sociology, economics, etc., must be clearly integrated into the ecology and scientific goals of the project. This grant aims to support work of the highest international standard. Applicants will need to show how the work will advance ecological science. This grant can be used for new and innovative ecological research. We provide funding for researchers from all countries globally. Projects can be conducted anywhere in the world.

opportunities.title: BES Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.summary: This grant supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK. Funding is intended to support travel from the applicant’s country of residence in the Global South to the UK and return travel to that country after the meeting.

opportunities.title: John L Harper Award

amount.raw: Awarded an additional small research grant each year

opportunities.summary: The John L Harper award allows the BES to award an additional small research grant each year to research projects that are broadly consistent with the research themes advanced by the late John L. Harper.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants

amount.raw: Up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants

opportunities.summary: This grant aims to bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis while fostering collaboration and mentoring opportunities.

opportunities.title: Long-term Research Grants

amount.raw: £3,500 for the first five years, with an additional £3,500 available after the initial five years

opportunities.summary: This grant will provide a small amount of funding each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects with at least 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term.
